We are 100% Canadian Building Materials Supplier for commercial, residential & industrial construction projects. For more than 30 years, Dass Building Materials has proudly catered construction materials to Canadian homeowners and contractors, providing dependable professional service. We use world-class technology to ensure we deliver the right building material so our Canadian projects are always a success.

Best Building Materials At the Best Possible Prices

We are reducing commercial construction operating costs and helping create more efficient, sustainable residential and commercial buildings materials. We’re providing specialized construction materials like steel studs, frames & steel stud drywall for a greener, healthier world. Our Dass Pro Stud features a lightweight and high-strength steel combined with an innovative design that performs better than any similar product in the market.

Top Building Material Supplier In Canada

We are trusted building material supplier in Canada from the last 30 years with excellent technical expertise and guaranteed quality. We are Canadian family business which is supplying building materials to construction industry in Canada. Our expert team will work with you to ensure the building products and building supplies you need are the correct specifications, grading and sizes for your project so you can be sure of high quality, fully Canadian certified building products.
